nurse.text: Welcome to the Penzance Sanctuary. Dydh da! That's Cornish for 'hello'. I'm told it's pronounced differently by everyone. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Let me take a look. Mind the wind, it blows the paperwork.
All done. Meur ras, that's 'thank you'. I've practised it. Honest.
The Ark terminal. It runs on tea, tin and a very reliable gull.

else.text: No bother. Come in out of the rain. It's always raining. It's a feature.
